auditable requirements可审计的需求项

Prompt提示词

Produce a Causal Explanation report answering: 'What are the metabolic effects of intermittent fasting and how do they manifest in terms of hormonal changes, insulin sensitivity, and body composition during the fasting period and refeeding phase?' The report is NOT a diet plan; it must build a causal chain from physiological mechanisms to observed outcomes. Generate a report that includes: - A minimum of 120 sandbox URLs, with at least 60 cited. - Sources: __SHOPPING__ (30 metabolism supplements, intermittent fasting guides, fasting equipment, health watches, fitness tracking devices, meal prep containers, weight loss programs, dietary supplements, fitness books), __REDDIT__ (30 threads from AskReddit, LifeProTips, Fitness, nutrition, health, AskScience, r/Fasting, r/WeightLoss), __WIKIPEDIA__ (Intermittent fasting, Metabolism, Weight loss, Caloric restriction, Fasting-mimicking diet, Autophagy, Hormonal changes during fasting, Insulin sensitivity, Body composition, Health benefits of intermittent fasting, plus an additional 15 relevant articles). The report must be formatted in markdown, with links to sandbox-local resources only, and no fabrication. Follow these synthesis requirements: - task_type: causal - causal_layers: [L1_physiology, L2_hormonal, L3_insulin_sensitivity, L4_body_composition] - min_wiki_per_layer: {L1_physiology: 3, L2_hormonal: 3, L3_insulin_sensitivity: 3, L4_body_composition: 3} - min_reddit_per_layer: {L1_physiology: 5, L2_hormonal: 5, L3_insulin_sensitivity: 5, L4_body_composition: 5} - l4_must_have_explicit_percent: true - mitigation_strategies_min: 5 - min_evidence_per_strategy: {shopping: 1, reddit: 1} - model_ranking_min: 3 - min_reddit_per_model: 3 - explicitly_forbid_top10: true

Audit checklist审计清单

  1. 1Are there at least 120 sandbox URLs, with at least 60 cited?
  2. 2Do sources include __SHOPPING__, __REDDIT__, and __WIKIPEDIA__ with specified quantities?
  3. 3Is the report formatted in markdown?
  4. 4Are links to sandbox-local resources included?
  5. 5Is there no fabrication in the report?
  6. 6Does the report include task_type: causal?
  7. 7Does the report contain causal_layers: [L1_physiology, L2_hormonal, L3_insulin_sensitivity, L4_body_composition]?
  8. 8Is there a minimum of 3 articles per causal layer from Wikipedia?
  9. 9Is there a minimum of 5 threads per causal layer from Reddit?
  10. 10Does the report require explicit percentages in L4_body_composition?
  11. 11Are there at least 5 mitigation strategies mentioned?
  12. 12Is there at least 1 piece of evidence per mitigation strategy from shopping?
  13. 13Is there at least 1 piece of evidence per mitigation strategy from Reddit?
  14. 14Does the report include a model ranking with a minimum of 3 models?
  15. 15Are there at least 3 threads per model from Reddit?
  16. 16Is the report explicitly forbidden from top 10 sources?
  17. 17Is there product/data coverage of at least 5+ items?
  18. 18Is there community sentiment analysis of at least 3+ items?
